Exposed V1 facts

  • Typed official identifier
  • Legal/entity name
  • Normalized status with source value/label
  • Entity/legal type
  • Registration or establishment date
  • Published registered/business address
  • Industry/activity code
  • Official-source provenance and retrieval time
  • Freshness and source-scope warnings

Directors, officers, shareholders, owners, UBO data, personal identifiers, personal residential addresses and paid filings are not exposed.

Freshness and scope

Per-entity official API; registry refresh cadence is not stated in the verified source material.

Published scope: National register of legal entities and other registered units; not companies-only

  • Enhetsregisteret includes sole proprietorships, associations and other legal entities; it is not companies-only.
  • HTTP 410 means withdrawn for legal reasons and must remain distinct from not-found; V1 stores no record.
  • Enhetsregisteret is Norway's national legal-entity register and is not limited to companies.

Request example

curl -X POST https://business.newbies.cool/api/v1/business/lookup \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: <x402-v2-payment>' \
  --data '{   "jurisdiction": "NO",   "scheme": "no-organisasjonsnummer",   "identifier": "000000000" }'

The request body is syntactically validated before an x402 challenge. The official entity source is queried only after successful payment settlement.

Important

Global Official Business Facts is not an official registry.

Facts are retrieved from identified official sources and normalized for machine use. Source scope, update frequency and legal meaning vary by jurisdiction. For authoritative or legally certified information, consult the originating registry.

Source-linked official facts · typed identifiers · no scraped global company master database
